soon.metaDesc: UXGate is UX practice in Arabic and English: short lessons where you fix real screens. Get one email when we open.
soon.over: UX practice in Arabic and English
soon.title: Practise real design decisions.
soon.lead: Short lessons where you fix real screens, get feedback that explains why, and prove each skill on a new case.
soon.formLbl: Get one email when we open
soon.netBody: Check your connection and try again. What you typed is still here.
soon.rateBody: Wait a few minutes, then try again. What you typed is still here.
soon.consent: We only email you about the launch, and you can leave the list at any time. See our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
soon.sentB: We sent a link to <mail>{email}</mail>. Tap it to join the list.
soon.sentNote: Not there? Check spam or promotions. The link works for 7 days.
soon.alreadyB: <mail>{email}</mail> is on the launch list. We’ll email you once, when we open.
soon.queuedB: We’ll email <mail>{email}</mail> a link to confirm it soon. Keep an eye on your inbox.
soon.confL: We’ll email <mail>{email}</mail> once, when UXGate opens.
soon.expiredB: Confirmation links work for 7 days. Enter your email again and we’ll send a new one.
soon.memL: Your account is ready. Lessons open on launch day.
soon.memPB: One email to <mail>{email}</mail> on launch day. Your account stays as it is until then.
soon.get1b: Each step puts a real screen in front of you and asks what you would change.
soon.get2b: Right or not, you see what your choice does to the people using it.
soon.get3t: Prove it on a new case
soon.get3b: Each unit ends with a skill check on a screen you have not seen.
soon.get4b: Every lesson in both languages. Switch at any time, even mid-lesson.

pricingPage.metaDesc: UXGate pricing: practise UX for free on Unit 1 of every path, or subscribe to Pro for every unit, skill check and certificate. Monthly and yearly plans in US dollars.

pricingPage.lead: Start free. Go Pro when you want every unit of every path.
pricingPage.free2: Skill checks on the free units
